headline: Deployment of New Power Grid Construction Tasks Launched; Grid Equipment ETF E Fund (560390) Tracked Index Rises 2.2%
summary: The Hang Seng A-share grid equipment index rose 2.2% on September 9 after the National Energy Administration held a work meeting on new grid construction; two cable makers hit the daily limit.
why: Grid equipment makers supply cables and transmission hardware for power network expansion, so their shares track state investment in grid infrastructure.
